articles.summary: All the key moments from the 2026 Hungarian Grand Prix. Hungary played host to another enthralling weekend of F1 action before drivers and teams headed into the summer break, with Lando Norris and McLaren bagging their first win in 2026 to properly join the fight at the front.

articles.title: Hamilton despairs of ‘costly mistakes’ in Hungarian GP
articles.summary: Hamilton despairs of ‘costly mistakes’ in Hungarian GP. Lewis Hamilton’s title ambitions suffered another blow as he finished fifth at the Hungarian Grand Prix.

articles.title: Piastri reacts to ‘getting taken out by a backmarker’ in Hungary
articles.summary: Piastri reacts to ‘getting taken out by a backmarker’ in Hungary. Oscar Piastri has admitted “everything that could have gone wrong did” as he went from challenging for victory in the Hungarian Grand Prix to a painful retirement – via an unusual run-in with Carlos Sainz’s Williams.

articles.title: Antonelli shares positives from ‘tough race’ in Hungary

articles.summary: Verstappen buoyed by P2 finish in race of ‘survival’. Max Verstappen expressed his surprise and satisfaction after coming away from the Hungarian Grand Prix with a P2 finish, having struggled in Qualifying and described his race as one of “survival”.

articles.summary: Will McLaren’s Budapest breakthrough turn the tide?. The reigning F1 world champions’ first win of the season was all the more encouraging for how decisive its race pace advantage looked.

articles.summary: Hamilton questions late pit stop as podium slips away. Lewis Hamilton feels he missed out on a podium finish in the Hungarian Grand Prix as a result of Ferrari’s late call to make a pit stop under virtual safety car that cost him track position.

articles.title: Sainz defends Piastri contact amid blue flag issues

articles.title: Malaysia back on F1 calendar as Bahrain stand-in
articles.summary: Malaysia back on F1 calendar as Bahrain stand-in. The Sepang International Circuit will return to Formula 1 later this year as host for the postponed Bahrain Grand Prix, which will be known as "the 2026 Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia."

articles.summary: How Norris shifted Hungary’s qualifying formbook from red to papaya. The Hungaroring was expected to suit the Scuderia’s 2026 car, but as McLaren learned from its upgrade and Lando Norris grew in confidence, the combination managed to make a step forward on Saturday.

articles.title: Mercedes changes Russell’s power unit without penalty after qualifying issue
articles.summary: Mercedes changes Russell’s power unit without penalty after qualifying issue. George Russell will use a new power unit for the Hungarian Grand Prix after a water leak forced him to stop on track at the end of qualifying, but has avoided a grid penalty.

articles.title: Hamilton demoted from front row for impeding Piastri
articles.summary: Hamilton demoted from front row for impeding Piastri. Lewis Hamilton has lost his front row start and been handed a three-place grid penalty for impeding Oscar Piastri in qualifying for the Hungarian Grand Prix.

articles.summary: Is Verstappen to Mercedes a likely move?. BBC Chequered Flag podcast experts Sam Bird and Rebecca Clancy discuss the liklihood of Red Bull's Max Verstappen making a move to rivals Mercedes.
